item.title: Introducing dir, an open directory and standing request for CKB-native ideas (2 posts)
item.description: Hello, I’m working on VibeQuest is an AI gamified learning workbench for CKB/Fiber. It turns a learner’s goal into AI-generated lessons, checkpoint questions, lesson-based code quests, verifier files, denial tests, and boss challenges so people do not just vibe-code CKB apps, they understand the Cell model, scripts, witnesses, Fiber payment proofs, and replay risks. Would VibeQuest fit dir as a CKB-native idea under AI/onboarding/education? My aim is to use our upcoming beta for validation from the CKB ecosystem: builders can test the learning loop, suggest better acceptance criteria, and help decide which CKB/Fiber concepts should become quests first. item.title: Deep Dive Into CKB-VM Macro-ops Fusion (4 posts)
item.description: Deep Dive Into CKB-VM Macro-ops Fusion Overview Macro-Operation Fusion (MOP Fusion) is a performance optimization technique used in modern microprocessor architectures. During instruction decode, several adjacent macro-operations are merged into a single internal micro-operation, reducing dispatch overhead and execution cycles. This technique is widely used in high-performance microarchitectures for mainstream architectures such as x86 and ARM, and it can also be implemented at the virtual-machine layer through the decoder. item.description: The Invisibook Reddit AMA Recap Invisibook is a privacy-preserving, censorship-resistant, decentralized order book with a purely cryptographic stack. item.title: [DIS] Werra: Building Trust Infrastructure for Creator Commerce (1 posts)
item.description: We have updated the proposal to include the live Werra POC link: werra-tau.vercel.app werra The POC is now available for community testing. It currently supports email-based sign-in with managed CKB testnet wallets, separate SME and creator workspaces, brief posting, creator applications, gig awarding, escrow funding, delivery submission, payout approval, and dispute opening. This is still a proof of concept, but it gives the community something practical to test and critique before we move toward full development. We would really appreciate feedback on the product flow, escrow experience, and any concerns around how CKB is being used in the workflow.

item.title: Scryve is live - Publish long-form essays with certified authorship and permanent archiving (1 posts)
item.description: Hi all, After months of heads-down building, Scryve is live at scryvehq.com. It is a long-form publishing platform made for essays and deep writing rather than short posts. The idea is simple. Writers should own what they publish and be supported directly, without a platform in the middle taking a large cut and holding the archive hostage. Scryve let us actually deliver that. What you can do on Scryve Publish long-form articles in a clean editor, with Markdown, code blocks, images, and embeds.
